title: Global hedge funds suffer steep losses as AI trade unwinds, Asia funds hit hardest
description: Global hedge funds suffered steep losses as investors unwound artificial intelligence-related trades amid inflation concerns and expectations of higher interest rates. Asia-focused stock pickers were hit hardest, losing 6.8% in early October, while global fundamental long-short funds fell 2.9% through October 15, according to Goldman Sachs data cited by Reuters.
